identity.name: XRP MineSim
identity.vibe: Futuristic, High-Stakes, Gamified, Dark Mode Only

typography.instructions: Import 'Unbounded' from Google Fonts. Use it for all H1-H3 headings. Use 'JetBrains Mono' for all numbers, hashes, and balances.

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-white font-bold uppercase tracking-wider hover:bg-blue-600 rounded-none border border-blue-400/30 shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(59,130,246,0.4)]
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-white/20 text-white hover:bg-white/5 rounded-none

cards.default: bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-md border border-white/10 p-6 rounded-none relative overflow-hidden group

inputs.default: bg-white/5 border-white/10 text-white placeholder:text-gray-500 focus:border-primary focus:ring-1 focus:ring-primary rounded-none h-12

images.description: Futuristic server room, dark blue tones. Use as background for Landing Page Hero with overlay.
Abstract geometric blue shapes. Use in the center of the Mining Page. Rotate this image when mining is active.
Gold coin close up. Use for 'Daily Reward' or 'Balance' cards.

assets.icons: Use 'lucide-react' for all UI icons (Wallet, Pickaxe, History, Users, Trophy).

landing.structure: Hero (Headline + CTA) -> Features Grid (Bento) -> Live Stats -> Footer

dashboard.grid_layout: Grid cols-1 md:cols-3 gap-6. Balance (col-span-2), Daily Reward (col-span-1), Mining Status (col-span-3), Recent History (col-span-3)

mining.stats: Display 'Hash Rate', 'Session Time', 'Accumulated XRP' in real-time (odometer effect).

universal_guidelines: DO NOT use gradients for text.
DO NOT use rounded corners > 4px. Prefer sharp edges (rounded-none or rounded-sm) for a 'Cyber' feel.
ALWAYS use 'JetBrains Mono' for displaying crypto addresses, transaction hashes, and balance numbers.
Ensure all interactive elements have a hover state that increases brightness or adds a glow.
Use 'sonner' for all notifications (Mining started, Withdrawal requested).
Dark Mode is MANDATORY. Do not implement a light mode toggle.
